references.text: Describes the same promise of a good land with houses, wells, vineyards, and olive trees that Israel will inherit without having worked for it.
Joshua reminds the people that God gave them a land they had not struggled for, cities they had not built, vineyards and olive groves they had not planted.
Nehemiah describes how the Israelites took fortified cities and a fertile land, houses full of good things, hewn wells, vineyards, and olive trees.
The psalm praises God for giving them the lands of other nations, which they inherited from peoples who had worked for it.
The preceding verse describing the great and good cities that God gives them, which they did not build themselves.
The following warning not to forget the Lord when they enjoy all these blessings.
